profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Axon
profile.summary:
I am a Javascript developer primarily spending my time in the React ecosystem. I enjoy learning new things and jumping in on projects that push and develop my skills.

I love new technology, have a passion for elegant and functional UI design, and strive to produce quality code that is maintainable and easy to understand.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
Implemented new features and fixed bugs filed in Jira for the front end (Backbone.js SPA) and the back end (Java server/RPC API)

Identified and established patterns for Backbone to React migration

Created React component to reduce complexity by abstracting React view layer from Backbone model layer

Updated Jenkins build system to take advantage of pipelines and make code the source of truth

Optimized webpack config which decreased build times by ~30% on dev builds

UI/UX design to create a friendlier and more accessible UI for users

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
Created MySQL/MSSQL container test framework to catch regression in backend code

Setup automated UI test suite with Cypress and Jenkins

Add features/fix bugs in front end (Backbone) and back end (Java) found during QA

Created Docker container of webapp to replace VM dev environments and streamline manual and automated QA processes

Created robust testing plan that decreased amount of bugs released into production

Coordinated QA team throughout testing phase of new product and feature update

positions.title: Javascript App Developer
positions.description:
Programming educational apps in HTML5/Javascript that run on Windows, Mac, Android, and iOS platforms.

Primarily used AngularJS, Ionic framework, Bootstrap, and Cordova for development.

Also provide technical support to customers on Windows, Mac, and mobile devices to troubleshoot problems with software and provide tech support within office when needed.

educations.degreeName: Associate of Applied Science CIS Software Development

projects.title: Product release test plan
projects.description:
Implemented a continually updated plan to test new releases of Netx's main and secondary products.
A new release is tested following the plan and any bugs/problems that are found are tracked in Jira and Google Docs.

projects.title: Cross platform educational apps
projects.description:
Used Angular, Cordova, Ionic, Electron, and Bootstrap to create three cross platform educational apps that teaches different word parts and how they are composed into full words using a variety of different activities.
Cordova/Ionic were used to build the apps for the iOS App Store and Android Play Store, while Electron was used to build the apps for the Windows and Mac platforms.
